report_topic: Performance Audit on E-way Bill System under GST
observations_summary: The audit identified significant system deficiencies in the E-way Bill system under GST, leading to revenue leakage. These included allowing EWB generation by non-filers and cancelled taxpayers, issues with multiple/single EWBs for the same invoice, and lack of validation controls, all contributing to tax evasion and inaccurate reporting.
